plan.cardStateContract: Final retreat and final idle both require priorCards=2. Raw source proof movies are not composited and do not prove card persistence.
plan.seamCounting: N played segments yield N-1 joins in a linear sequence; replay adds last-to-first. One 12s source has zero internal edits only when played continuously. Extracting or rearranging variants creates a join at every non-consecutive source-frame transition, even from the same file. Two 12s sources played once back-to-back have one join; looping both adds a second transition. This six-segment demonstration has five joins and must not auto-loop because the initial scene has zero cards and the final scene two.
